scope: NuminaMath-CoT 训练候选题源抽样方案(采样前锁定;抽样后记录实际选中与每条排除理由)
algorithm: Before ranking, freeze semantic-core families and subject/difficulty mapping. Rank stable family representatives using the fully specified sort key; groups never cross uses/splits. Selection remains DESIGN until integer subject/difficulty quotas, count unit, within-family representative rule and shortage rule are locked.

strata.note: Codex 854 口径:标记不等于现成中文,语言逐条实测;若实测与分层不符则重定

group_core_rules: 相同 problem 文本跨层/重复 → 视为同核心族,整体一组分配用途,不逐行随机切开
翻译版本与原文同族(该集处理链含译英)
同核心族按组进出,不按行切开
exclusion_rules: 题解不匹配(独立数学核验失败)
与 holdout 391 候选池、现有 train/eval/test、外测集语义核心冲突(泄漏审查阶段判定,CLEAR/CONFLICT/UNKNOWN 各记)
许可未决记录(上游来源许可无法核验者)
expansion_rule: 首批各层按质量信号(独立数学核验通过率)加权扩配额,总量≤2000;任何单层不超过其首批配额的 10 倍
insufficiency_rule: 某层合格数不足配额时如实报告不足与原因,不造数值变体凑数
post_sampling: 记录实际选中清单与每条排除理由
records.jsonl:source_record_id/raw_record_sha256/problem/solution 原始来源/语言/学科难度/转换器 SHA/勘误版本/独立数学理由
leakage-review.jsonl 绑定 train/eval/test、外测与适用 holdout 各版本 SHA,独立理由与处置

sort_key_encoding.serialization: JSON array, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon), no newline

required_before_execution: Lock subject/difficulty integer quotas summing to the approved batch target
Lock count unit and family representative/group-cost rule; source-layer quotas alone are insufficient
Include shard path so equal row_index values from different files cannot collide
Verify fixed revision and actual source file hashes
Complete license/math/leakage review and authorized candidate intake
